This '''clone of Feena D'Asta''' took her place after the real [[Feena D'Asta]] was kidnapped by [[Grappa (Hutt)|Grappa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].

==Biography==
[[File:Feena.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Attempting to kill her template]]
When her father, [[Ragez D'Asta]], retired from the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] sometime after her kidnapping, he appointed [[Feena D'Asta|Feena]] to take his place, not knowing the daughter he was appointing was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]].

The clone was inserted into the Council, where she participated in the plotting of [[Carnor Jax]] and later advocated an end to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. She was falsely suspected of having [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] [[Burr Nolyds]], and called for a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] against [[Xandel Carivus]]&mdash;who had her arrested for [[Treason/Legends|treason]].

[[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] agent [[Mirith Sinn]] attempted to rescue her, but was captured herself. It fell upon [[Kir Kanos]] to rescue both women. He then returned the clone to her father, who opted to isolate his sector from both the New Republic and the Imperial Remnant.
